jaya.p: [Jana+a] (pu,na) CL=8 (1) overcome or success, to win, victorious (or) overcome. (2) to success, to overcome, when to overcome (such as period). Jayaddhaja- see. (Ti) (3) viturious, win or success, who is overcome/success; he/ (4) should be overcome (things/property/possession). Jayadhana-see also. Jaya jaya(kri) [ji+a+hi] be victoriouos (or) be overcome (or) be success. Jayati - see.

Jaya，[see jayati] vanquishing，overcoming，victory D．I，10； Sn．681； J．II，406； opp．parājaya Vism．401．

--ggaha the lucky die J．IV，322 （=kaṭaggaha，q．v．）； --parājaya victory & defeat Dh．201； --pāna the drink of victory，carousing，wassail； °ṁ pivati DhA．I，193； --sumana “victory’s joy，” N．of a plant （cp．jātisumana） Vism．174； DhA．I，17，383．（Page 279）

Jayā，f．[Vedic jāyā] wife only in cpd．jayampatikā，the lady of the house and her husband，the two heads of the household．That the wife should be put first might seem suggestive of the matriarchate，but the expression means just simply “the pair of them，” and the context has never anything to do with the matriarchate．‹-› husband & wife，a married couple S．II，98； J．I，347； IV，70，of birds．See also jāyampatikā．（Page 279）

Jāyā，（f．） [from jan] wife Vin．II，259=264； J．IV，285．

--patī （pl．） husband & wife PvA．159； Dāvs．V，2．（Page 283）

[jaya + gaha 2 , gāha 2 ], a winning catch (at dice) ; Ja IV 322, 27´ (kaṭaggaho ti … °-ggāho, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se °-ggaho) ≠ Ps III 117, 24 (kaṭaggaho ti °-ggāho, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce kaṭaggāho ti) ≠ Spk III 110, 3 (kaṭaggaho ti °-ggaho, Ee so; Be, Se kaṭaggāho ti °-ggāho; Ce kaṭaggāho ti basaggāho[?]) = Mp III 377, 14 ( eds kaṭaggāho ti °-ggāho) = Sadd 640, 6 (kaṭaggāho ti °-ggāho) ≠ Th-a II 195, 17 (kaṭaggaho ti … °-ggaho, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-ggāho); Ja VI 282, 25´ (°-ggāhaṃ gaṇhi); Nidd-a I 90, 14 (°-ggāhaṃ gahetvā); — °- nāda , m. , a roar of victory ; Mhv 25:93 (Bhalluke patite tasmiṃ ~o pavattatha); — °- pāna , n. , a drink of victory, a feasting to celebrate victory ; Abh 398 (raṇe jitassa sampānaṃ ~aṃ); Ja VI 392, 4 (sakalajambudīpe rajjaṃ gahetvā ~aṃ pivissāmā ti); Dhp-a I 193, 14 (tayo divase ~aṃ pivi); — °- sadda , m. , a shout of victory ; Sv 149, 4 ; — °- sumana , n. , a tree (with [pale] red blossoms); SAF: shoe flower, Pentapetes phoenicea L. ; Abh 575 (bandhuko ~aṃ); Ja V 163, 21 (~-pupphasadisena sīsena); Sv 482, 5 (~-pupphavaṇṇā paṇḍukambalasilā, Ce so; Ee ~-pupphakavaṇṇā; Be, Se jayakusumapuppha-) = Ps I 225, 31 ( Be, Ce, Ee so; Se jayakusuma-); Ps V 7, 6 (paṇḍu-kambalasilāyan ti rattakambalasilāyaṃ, tassā kira rattakambalass’ eva ~-puppharāsissa viya vaṇṇo, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se ~-puppharāsi viya vaṇṇo); Dhp-a I 17, 8 ; Bv-a 84, 26 (~-kusumasadisaṃ … celavitānaṃ bandhitvā); 86, 21 (~-kusumasadisavaṇṇaṃ dupaṭṭa-cīvaraṃ timaṇḍalaṃ paṭicchādetvā); — see also jaya-kusuma above ; — dujjaya , mfn. and m. 1. ( mfn. ) hard to conquer; hard to win ; S I 162, 30* (kuddhaṃ appaṭikujjhanto saṅgāmaṃ jeti ~aṃ) = Th 442; It 76, 6* (yo tvaṃ ~am ajjhabhū jetvāna maccuno senaṃ; It-a II 75, 5 foll. : pacurajanehi jetuṃ asakkuṇeyyaṃ kilesavāhiniṃ abhibhavi); Sv 666, 7 (na sunimmadayā ti … duppajahā ~ā ti attho, Be, Ee so; Ce omits; Se dujjahā ti); — 2. ( m. ) a poor victory, a false victory ; Kv-a 16, 15 (sakavādissa pana paravādinā chalavādaṃ nissāya paṭikammaṃ katvā attanā sādhito jayo ~o); — sujaya , m. , a good victory, a real victory ; Kv-a 16, 18 (paravādissa pana sakavādinā dhammavādaṃ nissāya … jayo ~o ti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se omits ).

[ cf S. jāyāmpatika; BHS also jāyapatika, jāyāpatika], husband and wife ; S II 98, 9 (dve ~ā, Be so; Ce, Ee jayampatikā; Se jāyapatikā; Spk II 103, 25 : jāyā c’ eva pati ca); Ja I 301, 11 (jayampatikā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se jāyapatikā); IV 70, 13 (jayampatike dve cakkavāke disvā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se jāyapatike); Sv 180, 14 (dve ~ā vasanti, Be so; Ce, Ee jayampatikā; Se jāyapatikā); Ps I 211, 29 (dve kira ~ā, Be, Ee so; Ce jayampatikā; Se jāyapatikā); Mp I 169, 3 (dve ~ā, Be so; Ce, Ee jayampatikā; Se jāyapatikā); Dhp-a III 34, 20 (jayampatikā, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se jāyapatikā); Ud-a 198, 3 (te ~e … disvā, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se jayampatike); Vv-a 286, 25 (te dve ~ā, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se jayampatikā); Th-a II 187, 15 (puttamaṃsaṃ ~ā yathā … khādiṃsu, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee jayampatikā); Thī-a 172, 20 (ubho pi jāyāpatikā); Nidd-a I 455, 20 (~ānaṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee jayampatikānaṃ).

အတ္တနော ဇယေ ဝတ္တမာနေ၊ မိမိနိုင်သည်ရှိသော်။

jayā：ဇယာ （ဣ）
မယား။ ဘင်း，ဆေးခြောက်။ ရေသကျည်းပင်။Indian Hemp； Sesbania Ægyptiaca

jāyā：ဇာယာ （ဣ）
မယား။ မွေးဖွားသောသူ ဟူလိုသည်။
